sahneler.ust: The real cost of one exam for a teacher
sahneler.alt: Writing questions, building booklets, marking papers, analysis, reports
sahneler.metin: Writing questions, building booklets, marking papers one by one, analysing, writing reports. A single exam costs a teacher hours of work. With Netice, those hours become minutes.

sahneler.baslik: The whole exam, in one app
faydalar: Every step from question to report card
sahneler.metin: Netice brings the whole journey of an exam into one app: it prepares the questions, reads the answer sheets, analyses the results and writes the report. On your phone, your tablet and your computer.

kartlar: Questions, booklets and answer keys from notes
Any answer sheet, seconds per paper
Official reports, report cards, parent updates
sahneler.metin: Netice works in four steps. Prepare, scan, analyse and report. Now let's see what you gain at each step.

sahneler.baslik: Questions from your notes in minutes
faydalar: PDF, Word, Excel or a photo
Multiple choice, fill in the blank, matching
sahneler.metin: Upload your lesson notes; a PDF, Word, Excel file or a photo of a page. Netice turns them into multiple choice, fill in the blank, matching and open-ended questions. You simply pick the ones you like.

sahneler.baslik: Booklet, answer key and answer sheet
faydalar: Shuffled booklet versions A to H
An answer sheet made for the exam
sahneler.metin: Build a question booklet from your question bank in a few taps. Eight booklet versions, a detailed answer key by topic and an answer sheet made for the exam are prepared at once. Get them as Word or PDF.

faydalar: Your own sheet or a publisher's
ID number, full name, date of birth
sahneler.metin: Hold the camera over the paper; each sheet is read in a few seconds. Your own sheet, a publisher's sheet or an institution's sheet, it makes no difference. Coded fields such as ID number, full name and date of birth are read too. You can upload scanned PDF files in bulk.

faydalar: Difficulty and discrimination for every item
Success by topic and learning outcome
sahneler.metin: Netice uses methods accepted worldwide in measurement and assessment. It shows the difficulty and discrimination of every question, the reliability of the exam and whether the distractors work. You see at a glance which topic and which learning outcome needs more work.

sahneler.baslik: From student to school, at every level
sahneler.metin: Analysis doesn't stop at the class. Follow each student's progress, compare classes and review the whole school on a big screen. Netice tells you who needs support.

faydalar: Report cards, term and outcome reports
To parents via WhatsApp, Classroom and Moodle
sahneler.metin: Your analyses become reports with your institution's official letterhead and signature block. Report cards, end of term reports and learning outcome reports are ready in one tap. Send results to parents or export them to Classroom and Moodle.

sahneler.ust: A real exam rehearsal at home
faydalar: Print the booklet and answer sheet
Scan it and see your gaps
sahneler.metin: Netice isn't only for teachers. Anyone preparing for an exam can upload their own notes, books and documents and build their own practice exam. Print the booklet and the answer sheet, set the timer and sit it like the real exam. Then scan the sheet with your phone and instantly see your score and the topics you need to work on.

sahneler.baslik: From primary school to university, for everyone
sahneler.alt: 15 languages · Every country's grading system · Colourful templates for children
sahneler.metin: For everyone, from primary school teachers to university lecturers, from police academies to military schools, from tutoring centres to students preparing for exams at home. It works in fifteen languages with every country's grading system, and has colourful templates for young learners.
Student information is sensitive. Netice works without internet and doesn't ask you to create an account; your data stays only on your own device.
